q1_needs_attention.question: What needs my attention?
q1_needs_attention.prose_answer: Approve the Aug 15 Gusto payroll run ($418,910.40) before 5pm tomorrow — that one is unrecoverable. Then two fraud items: the 'updated remittance details' for Solent invoice INV-10452 ($27,650) came from solentmachining-ap.com, not Solent, and the 'wire instructions' note for Draw #4471 replies to harborline-banksecure.com. Do not action either; tell Ilya to pay only the account on file and confirm with Frank by phone. The Bill.com batch of 14 vendors, $97,425.55, has been unapproved since Aug 7, including Pemberton's $25,000 retainer. Frank moved his deadline up: FY27 financials, executed amendment and June AR aging by Aug 18, not the 25th. Derek's $4,230 expense report and Ruth's conveyor capex sign-off are both already past due. By Aug 15 you also owe Gail a countersigned D&O binder at $86,400 and a decision on the $58,400 warehouse P&C renewal.

items.why_it_qualifies: Hard, near-irreversible cutoff inside 48 hours: missing it means 50 people are not paid on Aug 15 and the fix is manual off-cycle payroll.

items.why_it_qualifies: Hazard requiring awareness even with no legitimate task attached: the real invoice is live and net-30 (due Aug 21), the sender domain is a lookalike of solentmachining.com, and the legitimate invoice explicitly says banking details did not change.

items.why_it_qualifies: Owner is the designated approver, the batch is four days past its approval date, and several line items (Fairhaven, Pemberton retainer, WeWork) are already past due — late fees and a strained auditor relationship are the cost of continued silence.

The revenue-recognition memo you told Karen you would write 'by end of week' on Jul 29 is still unwritten, and Nadia has been asking for it in writing since Jul 21 — fieldwork started Aug 11. You told Nadia 'won't slip again' and then missed the Aug 6 lease amortization schedule and related-party disclosures; the related-party note is still a half-finished draft. You told Karen you'd send Sam the final board financials slide by Aug 7 morning, before the deck went to the printer. Frank Mireles never got the Q2 compliance certificate you promised before Jul 28, even though he confirmed the R&D addback on Jul 24 and you're at 2.94x. And the Ironforge invoice IF-3312 apology you drafted on Aug 1 — 'releasing payment today' — was never sent. Due Friday: the FY27 budget calendar and Derek's one-page exception process.

q6_slipping_through_cracks.curator_notes: Ranked by consequence x invisibility x elapsed time. Every item passes both tests: a real dollar amount or stakeholder, plus a burial factor (bounce, bcc, attachment-only, quote-only, ambiguous owner, topic drift, auto-responder, off-thread personal address). Items the owner visibly engaged with — the unsent Ironforge draft, the missed rev-rec memo — are deliberately left in Q2 instead. The capex and expense-report items appear here as well as in Q1/Q3 because the burial, not the deadline, is what makes them dangerous.
